inputs.share_count_basis: 11,246,466,400 ordinary shares in issue (H1 FY2026 interim note 7); includes shares held by the RSU trustee, so it is at or above the diluted EPS denominator (basic 11,239.4m; basic = diluted EPS RMB0.79). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows.
inputs.cash_composition: 30 June 2026: cash and bank balances 21,080.4 + long-term bank deposits 5,425.8 + financial assets at FVTPL (bank wealth-management products) 11,110.5 = 37,616.7. Restricted (8.1) and pledged (20.0) deposits excluded. Lease liabilities (87.8) excluded under lease treatment (B).
inputs.interest_income_note: 579.7 interest income + 171.3 FVTPL investment gains (fair-value 45.4 + disposal 125.9), FY2025 AR note 6. Both stripped because their source assets (deposits and FVTPL products) are added to the bridge at value -- the matching-asset rule.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payment expenses' RMB76,839k (line 5878); no cash taxes on equity awards disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 all years)
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases RMB221.6m (H1 FY2026: 121.5m) for the RSU scheme -- roughly 3x the SBC charge, so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1748, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23T18:24Z. All flows and per-share values are built in RMB and converted to HKD at this rate for comparison with the HKEX quote. No dual listing exists for a parity check; HKD is pegged to USD so the rate moves with onshore CNY. Direction check: RMB1.411 FY2025 EPS x 1.1748 = HK$1.66 -> trailing P/E 25.0x at HK$41.52, consistent with the market's reported ~25x.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y CGB ~1.8% + China equity risk premium incl. country/A-H governance risk ~6.5-7.0% x beta ~1.0 gives a cost of equity of ~8.5-9.0%; debt is ~10% of capital at ~2.5% pre-tax. WACC 9.0% for all three scenarios. China sovereign/governance and key-person risk is charged here, once; competition, reputational-shock and input-cost risk live in the scenario flows and weights (no per-scenario WACC, no stacked premium).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease payment (FY2025 principal 130.5 + interest 6.2 = 136.7, 0.26% of revenue) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (87.8 at 30 June 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for cash tax is ex right-of-use depreciation (3,213.4 PPE + 19.0 intangibles = 3,232.4, 6.15% of FY2025 revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: None required -- the Group has no minority equity (H1 FY2026 MD&A); attributable = consolidated.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (SKILL.md row 2: non-US consumer operating company) with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied for currency (CNY flows / HKD quote), leases (B), and the excluded-income/matching-asset rule. Nongfu is China's #1 packaged water and sugar-free tea (East Leaf) producer with a 45% EBITDA margin and no NCI, so nothing routes it off the default engine. EBITDA DEFINITION: FY2025 operating EBITDA (pre-SBC, post-IFRS16, ex interest income and FVTPL gains, FX loss of 198.6 left in as noise) = PBT 20,917.6 + finance costs 66.9 - interest 579.7 - FVTPL gains 171.3 + D&A 3,392.6 + SBC 76.8 = 23,702.9 = 45.1% of revenue; H1 FY2026 on the same basis ~44.6%. FY0 CALIBRATION: EBIT 45.1 - 0.15 - 0.26 - 6.15 = 38.5% -> 20,250 vs reported PBT ex investment income + finance costs 20,233; NOPAT at 24.5% = 15,290 vs attributable NI 15,868 less ~570 after-tax investment income = ~15,300. Ties. TAX: FY2025 effective 24.1% (statutory 25% less ~0.8pp western-region/HNTE 15% concessions running to 2030); cash paid 4,466.6 was 21.4% of PBT on deferred-tax timing; 24.5% cash rate used flat. BALANCE-SHEET ANCHOR: 30 June 2026 interim. Two equity_bridge deductions make it consistent with discounting full-year FY2026 as year 1: (i) the RMB0.99/share FY2025 final dividend (11,134.0) was approved 19 May 2026, sat in 'other payables and accruals' at 30 June and was paid in August 2026 -- a buyer today does not get it; (ii) H1 FY2026 reported FCF net of interest received (6,891.9 - 283.0 = 6,608.9) is already inside the 30 June cash but is also inside the projected FY2026 flow, so it is removed once. Cross-check: the FY2025 year-end anchor (cash 11,177.6 + LT deposits 11,087.6 + FVTPL 7,555.4 - borrowings 4,390.0 = 25,430.6) less the dividend since paid = 14,296.6 vs this build's 32,431.2 - 11,134.0 - 6,608.9 = 14,688.3; the ~390 gap is FVTPL/deposit revaluation, grants, FX and buybacks in H1. WORKING CAPITAL: receivables 4.5 days, inventory 95 days, but trade payables + contract liabilities + accruals/rebates far exceed them (NET CURRENT ASSETS only 2.2bn against 37.6bn of financial assets), so growth releases cash; FY2025 OCF exceeded NI + D&A by ~1.9bn on +9.7bn revenue (~20% capture). Base uses a modest 5% capture, bear 0%, bull 8%. GUIDANCE: management issues none; FY2026 year 1 anchored to H1 +16.0% against an H2 FY2025 comp of +30%, hence 13% base. SBC-light market: SBC 0.15% of revenue so the house/street band is nearly a point; band_position is reported but close to meaningless and should not be read as a finding.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2026-FY2028 average (13/10/8); historical 16-25% CAGRs span the FY2024 boycott trough and FY2025 recovery and are not extrapolated
historical_growth.notes: FY2020-FY2025, owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income (FVTPL gains additionally stripped in FY2025; not separately disclosed in the CSV for earlier years). Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (17.6%) is a touch below reported (18.5%) because interest income grew with the cash pile, not because SBC is growing -- SBC is 0.15% of revenue. The 3yr figures are flattered by a capex-heavy FY2022 base. Equity CAGR (20.6%) sits between revenue (18.1%) and EPS (24.1%); no >30% divergence.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 13%: H1 +16.0% (tea +30%, water +2%) against an H2 FY2025 comp of +30%. Tea decelerates from 30% as East Leaf's base doubles and fast-followers arrive; water grows low-single digits; functional/juice low-teens. Fades to 3% nominal by year 10.
base.margin_rationale: 45% held through year 5 (mix shift to higher-margin tea offsets PET/sugar cost normalisation and heavier S&D on new categories), then 0.5pp fade for competitive intensity.
base.capex_rationale: 12.5% in FY2026 (H1 ran 12.9%) while the remaining ~HK$4.3bn IPO proceeds are deployed into factories by end-2027, stepping down to 7.5% maintenance-plus-growth versus 7.0% D&A.

scenario_narratives.base: Tea (East Leaf) keeps compounding but decelerates from +30% to high-single digits as the category matures and C'estbon, Master Kong and Uni-President fast-follow; water recovers to low-single-digit growth with the 17-source network; functional and juice grow low-teens on scenario SKUs and Sam's Club. Group revenue growth fades 13% -> 3% over ten years. The 45% EBITDA margin holds through year 5 as tea mix offsets PET/sugar normalisation, then fades half a point. Capex steps down from the IPO-proceeds factory build (12.5%) to 7.5% maintenance-plus-growth. Negative working capital releases a little cash on growth (5% capture). Payout stays ~70% of profit, which is why the cash pile, not reinvestment, is the second-largest value item after the terminal.
scenario_narratives.bull: The health/low-sugar shift broadens East Leaf into a multi-SKU platform (chilled tea, carbonated tea, Tanbing coffee) and functional/electrolyte waters ride GLP-1-era sugar reduction; water regains mid-single-digit growth as the boycott fades from memory. Revenue grows 16% in FY2026 and is still 7% in year 6. Pricing discipline in e-commerce and scale on a 60%+ gross margin lift EBITDA margin to 47%. Working capital capture 8%. Terminal growth 3.5%, consistent with China nominal consumption.
scenario_narratives.bear: A second reputational shock of the 2024 kind (the Zhong Shanshan key-person axis) or a sharper Chinese consumer slowdown knocks FY2027 growth to 3% and it never recovers above 3%; sugar-free tea becomes a price-led category as rivals subsidise shelf space and East Leaf loses its margin premium; PET resin and sugar reverse FY2025's windfall. EBITDA margin compresses 5pp to 40% and stays there. Capex is cut to 7.5% from year 6 as growth projects are shelved. No working-capital release. Terminal growth 2.5% and a 16x cap, as a slower structural grower.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 20%: the business has already demonstrated that a viral controversy unrelated to product quality can take ~20% out of its largest segment inside a quarter, and the key-person/governance concentration (Yangshengtang control, related-party agreements) that caused it is unchanged. Bull trimmed to 30%: it needs tea to keep growing double digits AND margins to expand 2pp while rivals attack the category -- two independent things going right. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Nongfu Spring is valued on owner FCF: reported FCF less the (tiny) SBC charge and less the interest and wealth-management gains earned on a RMB37.6bn pile of deposits and bank products, which are instead added back at value in the bridge net of the RMB11.1bn dividend paid in August 2026 and the H1 FY2026 flow already in the cash. The engine capitalises a 45% EBITDA / ~23% owner-FCF margin business whose growth fades from the post-boycott 16-22% recovery to China nominal growth over ten years, at a 9% CNY WACC that carries the country and governance risk once. The water-source moat and the East Leaf franchise are real; what the price pays for is how long tea compounds before competition turns it into a price category, and how often the founder's public profile puts the brand at risk.
key_risks_to_valuation: Reputational/social-media shock tied to Chairman Zhong Shanshan -- the 2024 boycott cut water sales ~21% and group profit growth to 0.4%; the bear path assumes a repeat and is weighted 20%
Sugar-free tea competition: East Leaf is 44% of revenue and grew 30% in H1 FY2026; fast-following by CR Beverage, Master Kong and Uni-President could compress both growth and the margin premium
Input-cost reversal: FY2025's 2.4pp gross-margin gain was partly PET resin, packaging and sugar deflation that can reverse with oil
Chinese consumer slowdown: ~100% of revenue is mainland China; retail sales growth has run 1-4%

Capex intensity: 12.9% of revenue in FY2025 and H1 FY2026 while IPO proceeds are deployed; the model assumes it halves to 7.5% by year 9 -- if the 17-source build-out continues at this pace, owner FCF margin stays ~5pp lower
Currency: a buyer in HKD owns RMB flows; CNY depreciation lowers every per-share value here one-for-one via fx_rate, which refresh_price.py does not update
